q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time Left Until Resolution
Today is 2026-08-18. NVIDIA is scheduled to report Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026. This means resolution occurs in **8 days**. The forward guidance will be provided during the earnings release/call.

## (b) Most Likely Outcome and Why

NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which implies a range of $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion.

This guidance was provided on May 20, 2026 (during their Q1 FY2027 earnings call), approximately 3 months before the Q2 earnings release. The research clearly states this is NVIDIA's "own guidance" for Q2 FY2027.

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm, slightly adjust, or provide updated guidance very close to this $91.0 billion figure when they report on August 26, 2026. Companies typically either:
1. Reaffirm previous guidance if nothing has materially changed
2. Raise guidance if results track ahead of expectations
3. Lower guidance only if significant headwinds emerge

Given that:
- Q1 FY2027 came in at $81.6 billion (strong 20% sequential growth)
- The guidance already incorporated a 94% year-over-year growth rate (vs Q2 FY2026's $46.743 billion)
- NVIDIA's data center business remains robust
- No research mentions any significant negative developments since May

The most likely scenario is guidance remains in the $89-93 billion range, centered around $91 billion.

## (c) What Would Push the Value Lower?

- Unexpected deterioration in data center demand or customer spending patterns
- Geopolitical developments affecting China exposure or supply chains
- Competitive pressure or loss of market share
- Macroeconomic slowdown affecting AI investment
- However, with only 8 days to resolution and guidance already set, major downward revisions are unlikely unless something dramatic emerged in the past week

## (d) What Would Push the Value Higher?

- Better-than-expected demand tracking through August
- Customer prepayment patterns suggesting stronger demand
- Upside surprise in non-data-center segments (Gaming, Professional Visualization, etc.)
- Strength in international markets
- NVIDIA has a track record of beating guidance, suggesting potential for upside

## (e) Base Rate or Historical Reference Values

From the research provided:
- NVIDIA's stated Q2 FY2027 guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (range: $89.18–$92.82 billion)
- Current analyst consensus estimates: $91.846 billion to $93.5 billion
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6 billion
- Sequential growth from Q1 to Q2 guidance: approximately 11.5% ($81.6B → $91.0B)

NVIDIA has historically guided conservatively and often beaten guidance, suggesting potential for upside to the $91B midpoint.

---

## Probability Distribution

The research provides explicit Q2 FY2027 guidance of $91.0 billion ± 2%, implying the company's own forward guidance range is $89.18–$92.82 billion. With only 8 days until the earnings release, and no material negative developments reported, the most probable outcome clusters tightly around this already-published guidance.

The range provided (99.5–115.5 billion) extends well above current guidance and analyst consensus, suggesting the forecaster may be testing for upside scenarios. However, for a company to revise guidance *upward* by 8–27% in the final week before earnings would require exceptional circumstances not evident in the research.

My distribution:
- Heavy concentration around $91.0 billion
- Modest upside tail toward $93–95 billion (NVIDIA's historical beat rate)
- Small downside tail toward $88–90 billion (conservative scenarios)
- Very low probability of guidance above $100 billion or below $85 billion

**Low (10th percentile): 89180000000**
**Median (50th percentile): 91000000000**
**High (90th percentile): 93500000000**
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to report its fiscal Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026, after market close, with an earnings call at 5:00 PM ET [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, provided on May 20, 2026, projects revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). This guidance significantly exceeds the average analyst estimate of $86.84 billion at the time [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). Consensus estimates for Q2 FY2027 revenue currently range from approximately $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors) to $93.5 billion [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

NVIDIA reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion, up 20% quarter-over-quarter and 85% year-over-year, largely driven by its Data Center unit, which accounted for $75.2 billion (92% of total sales) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). The company's Q2 FY2027 guidance implies a 94% year-over-year growth compared to Q2 FY2026 revenue of $46.743 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
